expectations.text: Pushes back on the 'are you sure?' modal as the primary fix
Explains habituation or click-through blindness as why frequent dialogs stop working
Recommends reversibility (soft delete with a retention window) as the strongest option
expectations.evidence: move workspaces to a 30-day trash / soft-delete state

expectations.text: Recommends grace-period undo as a strong low-friction option
Recommends type-the-workspace-name confirmation for the irreversible case
expectations.evidence: require typing its name to confirm

expectations.text: If a dialog is retained, requires it to name the workspace and the scale of what is lost
expectations.evidence: Name the exact workspace and what will be lost. State retention/reversibility honestly.

expectations.text: Notes that the server must enforce the deletion rules, not just the UI
expectations.evidence: server enforce the retention and authorization rules—hiding or gating the UI alone won't protect the data

expectations.text: Gives an explicit preference order rather than an undifferentiated list of ideas
expectations.evidence: Use a reversible delete instead (primary) vs If permanent deletion is needed (conditional secondary)
